title: A renamed Default shows its current name
refs: SV-11694 (Story 2 S2-R14 S2-R28 S2-R5),SV-11718 (Reports Story 1 S1-R8)
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Make sure Default has its original name, Default.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, with a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $135.00 by Default, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click Default's row.
  3. Click Default's name at the top of the page.
  4. Type Retail.
  5. Press Enter.
  6. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  7. Pick customer B in the Customer filter.
  8. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  9. Click Retail's row.
  10. Click Retail's name at the top of the page.
  11. Type Default.
  12. Press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 2:

  • Default's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name can be edited.

Step 4:

  • The name reads Retail.

Step 5:

  • The title reads Retail.

Step 6:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 7:

  • Customer B's row reads 1 · Retail with Parts Invoiced $135.00 ($100.00 × 1.35).
  • No row reads Default.

Step 8:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 9:

  • Retail's page opens.

Step 10:

  • The name can be edited.

Step 11:

  • The name reads Default.

Step 12:

  • The title reads Default again.
